name: editorial-article
description: Magazine-style long-form essay. Centered title block (volume kicker, H1, byline + read-time + date), then justified body with H2 subsections and italic emphasis (italic via *single asterisks* in text).
when_to_use: Long-form blog post, essay, op-ed, magazine piece. When the brief says 'article', 'essay', 'blog post', 'long-form piece'.

slot_hints.label: Byline
slot_hints.example: By Aria Chen · 12 min read · April 2026

slot_hints.label: Body paragraphs and sub-headings
slot_hints.example: Paragraphs alternate with level-2 sub-headings to break the essay into named movements. Use *italics* for tone shifts and quoted phrases.
